criteria_results.title: Total requests do not exceed 40 including discrete subparts
criteria_results.reasoning:
The document contains 34 numbered requests (RFP Nos. 1-34). I need to check whether any of these contain discrete subparts that each seek logically independent categories of documents.

Looking at the requests:
- RFP 18 has two subparts: (i) USB drives and removable storage devices, and (ii) laptops, desktops, and workstations. These are logically independent categories of tangible things. That adds 1 extra (2 subparts instead of 1), bringing the count to 35.
- RFP 19 lists multiple items (policies, procedures, controls, etc.) but these all relate to the same category: data security policies and procedures. Not discrete subparts seeking independent categories.
- RFP 20 lists multiple items but they all concern the same topic: access credentials and authorization records.
- RFP 22 lists multiple items but they all concern Ridgeline's acknowledgment of confidentiality.
- Other requests with multiple items listed are describing the same general category with examples, not discrete independent subparts.

Even counting RFP 18's two subparts as separate requests, the total would be 35 (33 single requests + 2 subparts from RFP 18), which is well under 40. The total does not exceed 40.
